title: Industrial robots per 10,000 manufacturing workers, top countries

source.name: World Robotics 2025 report (robot density by country)
source.publisher: International Federation of Robotics (IFR), via Supply Chain 247

notes: IFR World Robotics 2025: South Korea leads the world in robot density at 1,220 per 10,000 manufacturing workers, followed by Singapore (818), Germany (449) and Japan (446). Global average cited around 132.
